result_semantic_payload.summary: The device owner's chat account ("me" in /chat/account_main.log) makes a self-descriptive role boast in Chinese on 2024-07-03: "说实话这个盘我就是总操盘，钱都过我手" (I am the overall operator/handler of this scheme; all the money passes through my hands) and "群里那帮人只管拉人，账我来平" (the people in the group only recruit; I settle the accounts), followed on 2024-07-05 by "最近风控严，先停几天" (risk controls are tightening, pausing a few days). The FACT-grade statement is that these assertions were made. The owner's ACTUAL role can be stated only as a HYPOTHESIS — not an INFERENCE and certainly not a FACT — because the corroboration available is zero: the sole source is the account's own self-serving self-description, /ledger/flows.txt carries no identifier linking wallet-A/B/C to the account, no registry, event-log, execution or identity artifact exists in the corpus, and /README.txt explicitly records that no identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows. Separately and importantly, the delegated source scope 'windows' does not exist in this task: the task digest reports platforms [] and source_scopes [], so every Windows-specialist dimension (account logon/source-IP, execution traces, persistence, device activity) has zero coverage.
